blurb: Guests can enjoy various attractions including miniature golf, laser tag, go-karts, bumper boats, arcade games, and batting cages. The park offers group packages for corporate outings, church youth groups, school field trips, day care, and summer camps. Birthday parties and lock-in events are also available with customizable options.
